title: A City, Three Moods
intro: A café stop before the streets fill. An afternoon that asks for sharper lines. A dinner plan that deserves a little shine. Twelve complete looks follow a city through its changing moods. Dress for the moment. Keep your own rhythm.

chapters.title: Small joys
chapters.intro: The morning belongs to the little things. A good coffee. A new corner. A pause in the sun.

chapters.title: Clear lines
chapters.intro: As the afternoon moves, the shapes become a little sharper. Easy tailoring, warm colour and a moment before sunset.

chapters.title: After the light
chapters.intro: The city changes its light. A little shine, confident silhouettes and an evening on your own terms.
